diagnosis: Seat removals take effect at the next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle per kb-0011, which likely explains the invoice showing the prior seat count. The customer has supplied the invoice id, disputed line and expected amount, sufficient to open an invoice dispute review per kb-0009.
reply: Thank you for reaching out about invoice INV-88410 and the seat change on the 3rd. I want to clarify how seat removals affect billing: seat reductions take effect at the next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle, while seat additions are billed pro rata from the day they are added (see article kb-0011, "Seat count changes and billing impact"). This is likely why the invoice still reflects the previous seat count. That said, I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist so your invoice can be formally reviewed. Because you have provided the invoice id, the disputed line, and the amount you expected, our team has what is needed to investigate the dispute (see kb-0009, "Invoice disputes: what we need to investigate"), and the dispute will be held from collections while under review. Thank you for your patience.
